items.title: A $400,000 Portfolio in Bristol Myers Squibb, HP and KeyCorp Pays $15,806 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts

items.title: A $1,500,000 Portfolio in McCormick, PepsiCo and Bristol Myers Squibb Pays $61,489 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $1,500,000 portfolio split evenly across McCormick, PepsiCo and Bristol Myers Squibb pays about $61,500 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $5,120 a month. McCormick and Bristol Myers Squibb each paid out 55% of their free cash flow as dividends over the last twelve months, against 75% for PepsiCo.

items.title: Bristol-Myers Squibb Reports Mixed Phase 3 Trial Results for Sotyktu in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) announced mixed topline results from two pivotal Phase 3 clinical trials evaluating Sotyktu (deucravacitinib) in adults with moderate-to-severe systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), with one study meeting its primary endpoint and the other falling short. The pharmaceutical company plans to conduct a comprehensive assessment of the available clinical data and engage with health authorities regarding the findings.
